column1: Purpose: Log every bank's balance each day so you can see your total cash position over time.
1. Every day, enter that day's ending balance for each bank in its column below.
2. If the Bank is not based in USA, switch it to USD before logging it.
2. Total USD In Bank adds up all the bank columns automatically for that day. Don't type into it.
3. Estimated Income and Estimated/Known Debt are for your own reference — enter any income or debt you expect to hit that day.
4. The table is pre-built for every day of the year. Just fill in the rows as the days come.
